title: When Abundance Conceals Weakness: Knowledge Conflict in Multilingual Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-lingual knowledge conflicts by presenting multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) with contradictory external evidence in different languages. The framework measures Persuasion Rate (PR), Stubborn Rate (SR), and multi-source conflict accuracy across 10 typologically diverse languages to determine if models disproportionately favor evidence from high-resource languages (resource-driven authority) or linguistically affine languages.
